actions.description: Grievance registered under Approval Bureau by Dr. Arvind Sharma (ADMIN).

cases.title: Severe physical ragging and intimidation in Hostel Block 4
cases.description: First-year B.Tech students subjected to nighttime hazing, physical threats, and forced physical tasks by senior batches. College anti-ragging squad failed to take action despite formal written complaint to Chief Proctor.
cases.institutionName: Apex Institute of Advanced Technology & Research
cases.severityReason: Direct allegation of physical violence, senior batch intimidation, and institutional cover-up triggering statutory mandatory intervention.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-ARMC-01: Direct physical hazing / safety compromise requires immediate show-cause and police liaison within 24h.
cases.nextAction: Liaise with District Magistrate and conduct surprise evening hostel inspection with local police nodal officer.

actions.description: Authorized immediate 24h unannounced surprise flying squad raid led by Dr. K. M. Rao (Senior Inspector). Immediate raid authorized for Senior Hostel Block B.
Intake from National Anti-Ragging Helpline ref #NARH-MH-2026-8819.
Automated triage flagged severity as CRITICAL (score 98) due to violent hazing indicators.
Ordered formal inquiry team dispatch and sent emergency advisory notice to Institute Chairman.

cases.title: Unauthorized 120-seat MCA section and ghost faculty roster submitted for EoA
cases.description: Institute has admitted 120 students in an unsanctioned Master of Computer Applications (MCA) division not listed in current AICTE Approval Handbook. Furthermore, 8 faculty profiles submitted for Approval Renewal are non-resident ghost faculty.
cases.institutionName: Apex Institute of Advanced Technology & Research
cases.severityReason: Unapproved program enrollment places student academic degrees in legal jeopardy; ghost faculty compromises mandatory teacher-student ratio.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-AB-04: Fraudulent faculty roster and excess unapproved admissions trigger freezing of EoA pending expert committee.
cases.nextAction: Review formal reply to Show-Cause Notice sent on 16th Oct regarding unsanctioned MCA intake and verify biometric Aadhaar logs.

actions.description: Provisional sanction: Froze/reduced 60 intake seats pending compliance verification. Unapproved 120 MCA section detected. Freezing 60 seats pending biometric Aadhaar faculty verification.
Registered upon receipt of whistle-blowing faculty affidavit with roster comparison.
Issued formal show cause notice giving institute 7 working days to furnish biometric records.

cases.title: Suspected forged municipal building safety & fire NOC certificates
cases.description: Vigilance investigation into submitted documents for structural stability certificate and Municipal Corporation Fire NOC indicates fabricated registration stamps and signatures.
cases.institutionName: Apex Institute of Advanced Technology & Research
cases.severityReason: Compromised fire safety certificates in high-density multi-story engineering campus represents immense life safety hazard.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-VIB-02: Forged statutory safety compliance requires immediate cross-verification with municipal commissioner.
cases.nextAction: Dispatch certified letter to Pune Municipal Fire Department for physical verification of dispatch register.

actions.description: Issued statutory directive ordering refund of ₹1,80,000 within 7 days under penalty of approval forfeiture. College illegally withheld caution deposit and semester fee upon cancellation.
Logged vigilance case based on anonymous audit tip with scanned stamp discrepancies.

cases.title: Illegal capitation fee exaction and refusal to return original class 12 marksheets
cases.description: Management demanding ₹1.5 Lakhs unreceipted infrastructure development fee prior to issuing hall tickets; retaining original educational documents contrary to AICTE Gazette Notification.
cases.institutionName: St. Jude Institute of Engineering & Technology
cases.severityReason: Withholding marksheet documents directly prohibits student from applying for internships or competitive tests.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-PGC-03: Original document retention constitutes strict regulatory violation under Section 10.
cases.nextAction: Convene virtual grievance hearing between Student Council Representative and Principal on 27th Oct.

actions.description: Complaint submitted by parent association.
Summoned institution for conciliation hearing.

cases.title: High Court writ petition filed by institute contesting fee ceiling regulation
cases.description: Institute has obtained an interim status quo order from Karnataka High Court in WP No. 29104/2026 against AICTE state fee regulatory committee recommendations.
cases.institutionName: St. Jude Institute of Engineering & Technology
cases.severityReason: Legal stay impinges on parallel PGC hearings regarding student refund demands; requires coordinated counsel response.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-LAC-01: Ongoing litigation with interim order requires immediate alert to parallel grievance cells.
cases.nextAction: File statement of objections clarifying that document withholding is independent of fee slab litigation.

actions.description: Petition papers served by Standing Counsel.

cases.title: Non-payment of faculty salaries for 5 months and EPF deduction non-remittance
cases.description: 18 polytechnic instructors have not received monthly salary since May 2026 despite regular classes. Monthly salary slips show EPF deductions that were never deposited with EPFO portal.
cases.severityReason: Severe economic duress on teaching faculty threatens pedagogical continuity and violates mandatory service conditions.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-PGC-05: Non-payment of salaries beyond 90 days triggers punitive audit of institute bank accounts.
cases.nextAction: Escalate to Regional Officer for freezing of security deposit bank guarantee.

actions.description: Joint petition received from Faculty Welfare Association.
Issued Show Cause notice. Deadline lapsed without compliance.

cases.title: Deficient laboratory equipment in Mechatronics and Electrical Workshop

cases.severityReason: Deficient lab setup impacts practical curriculum; requires rectification before next semester exam cycle.
cases.severityRuleMatched: RULE-AB-02: Infrastructure deficit allows 30-day compliance window before reduction in intake.
cases.nextAction: Schedule surprise re-inspection of electrical workshops on 10th Nov.

actions.description: Registered following student complaint with photos.

cases.title: Non-refund of admission caution deposit to withdrawn candidate within statutory 15 days
